metadata.source: Government of India, Union Government Account — Monthly Trend
notes: Blank values in the source are represented as null, not zero.
March values for 2025-26 are marked provisional in the source.
The 2026-27 series contains values through September in this source.
For Investment(-) / Redemption (+) of Surplus Cash and Ways and Means Advances, the source provides year-to-date and up-to-date progressive values, not a monthly column.
